project_tracker_diagnostic: Perennial with sticky/resinous heads and often sticky upper parts; yellow heads with strongly recurved or spreading phyllaries and gummy involucres.

project_inclusion.learning_reason: Common and useful Central Texas field-learning taxon.

morphology_keys.leaves: Alternate, narrow to lanceolate, sessile or clasping, toothed to nearly entire.
morphology_keys.heads: Yellow rays and yellow disk florets; heads often very resinous/sticky especially in bud and involucre.
morphology_keys.phyllaries: Many, strongly recurved or spreading, often sticky.
morphology_keys.fruit: Cypselae with a pappus of short awns/scales.

photo_strategy.selection_logic: Prefer curated taxon photos plus multiple views from one Central Texas/Texas observation.
